# Manifest Template

Use schema 3 with objective, model-tier, workspace-isolation, proof-governor,
and pre-slice-review contracts. Include authoritative source hashes, one
reviewer or a specific skip reason, done check, ordered slices, gate ledger,
delivery authority, and plan-run worktree policy.

The `plan-to-work` gate names exact evidence and
`allowed_next_action: kb-work <manifest>`.
